plainText:
Volume 30: Onwards to Sinnoh...! is the 30th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto. It is the first volume in the .

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume one of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".

==Blurb==
Pokémon Trainers Pearl and Diamond are starstruck! Their lifelong dream is to floor an audience with their Pokémon comedy act. So how do they wind up as bodyguards to a pampered little rich girl on a quest to reach the peak of Mt. Coronet...?!

Come along and join the thrills and laughs as Pokémon Adventures continues!

Plus, meet Starly, Bidoof, Luxio, Combee, Bronzor, Rotom and many more Sinnoh Pokémon friends!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 338 - Stagestruck Starly
Chapter 339 - A Bevy of Bidoof
Chapter 340 - Extreme Luxio
Chapter 341 - Putting a Crimp in Kricketot
Chapter 342 - A Conk on Cranidos's Cranium
Chapter 343 - Honey for Combee
Chapter 344 - Belligerent Bronzor
Chapter 345 - Robust Rotom
Chapter 346 - Ring Around the Roserade I

==Important events==
 
and go on a journey with due to a misunderstanding.
Diamond and Pearl receive Pokémon and Pokédexes from Platinum.
Paka and Uji follow Diamond and Pearl, who they believe kidnapped Platinum.
The trio help an outcast Luxio back to its pride.
Platinum defeats Roark.
A shadowy character invades Valley Windworks to steal electricity. 
The trio encounter in the Old Chateau.
The trio meet Gardenia.
Tru, Chimler, and Piplup evolve at the exact same time.

==Party Changes==
===Additions===
Diamond's , "Tru" in PS338.
Pearl's , "Chimler" in PS338.
Platinum's Piplup, in PS338.

===Evolutions===
Diamond's "Tru" evolves into in PS346.
Pearl's "Chimler" evolves into in PS346.
Platinum's Piplup evolves into in PS346.

==Gym battles==
Platinum defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Roark in PS342

==Translation edits==
VIZ Media has started a "second series" with this volume, publishing the concurrently with older volumes from the , using this volume as #1 of the second series. Although it is unknown why they decided to release a second series (most likely to catch up with the series quicker), the reason behind why they are calling the "Diamond, Pearl and Platinum" (unlike in Japan, where D/P and Platinum are two separate chapters entirely) is most likely due to the fact that there is another Pokémon manga released by VIZ Media entitled Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!, which may have caused confusion if they had titled the second series "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond & Pearl".
